description: A mangled reference: the Carrier's booking reference arrives with its prefix stripped (E2's design: the Carrier invoice Logic App mangles it), so the line is an Unknown booking while an Open Carrier cost of the same Carrier with the full reference exists and ranks as a likely candidate. Known answer: Unknown booking, the candidate described as a likely candidate and never as certain, no Accept (the ERP allows only reject and wait). A likely candidate exists, so waiting for a cost under the stripped reference is not the answer: reject or needs-a-person.

setup.seed: Take a delivered Booking of CAR-0001 to an Open Carrier cost with the reference CB-20417. Submit the Carrier invoice EVAL-MANGLED-1 of CAR-0001 through the Partner API with one line whose reference is 20417 (prefix stripped) and the amount of the Carrier cost.

input: Explain why the line "20417" of Carrier invoice "EVAL-MANGLED-1" of Carrier "CAR-0001" did not match, and whether it may still resolve.

explanation.rubric: Says no Carrier cost has arrived under the reference 20417 (an Unknown booking). Names CB-20417 only as a likely candidate, never as certain and never says the line IS about it. Says whether the line may still resolve by itself. Does not propose accepting the line.
